title: Individual Responsibility
lead: The question whether a person answers for his own sin or for the sins of his parents and people. The Bible speaks of both: guilt that falls on families and nations (Exodus 20:5; 34:7; Lamentations 5:7), and the rule that each is put to death for his own sin (Deuteronomy 24:16; 2 Kings 14:6). The exiles' proverb about sour grapes (Ezekiel 18:2; Jeremiah 31:29–30) brought the question to a head.
